page.overview:
Who is Archaeornithoides?

is an extinct genus of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/troodontid troodont] theropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous in what is now Mongolia. The holotype discovered was found in the Djadochta Formation, which has many dinosaurs like Pinacosaurus, Shuvuuia, Goyocephale, Tsaagan, Velociraptor, Oviraptor, Avimimus, and Saurornithoides.

Archaeornithoides is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. However, it would receive a profile in the website Dinosaur Earth on Dinopedia.
